sources.title: Tourist Attractions
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.purpose: Attraction candidates from an older source snapshot. Operating status, names, entrances and access conditions need updating.
cautions: This is not a complete list of attractions currently operating.
Historical opening hours must not be assumed current.
Do not bulk-download or republish source photographs.

sources.title: Parks
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.catalogue_updated_note: Source shows relative update time; not converted to an exact timestamp
sources.purpose: Park candidate points. The official description identifies them as indicative points representing managed areas, not entrances.
cautions: Representative points must not be used as verified navigation entrances.
Records sharing a name and their associated boundaries require separate checks.

sources.title: NParks Parks and Nature Reserves
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.catalogue_updated_note: Source shows relative update time; not converted to an exact timestamp
sources.purpose: Park and nature reserve boundaries for map context, place association and future analysis of access within each area.
cautions: These are not the national boundary of Singapore.
Managed areas do not establish which areas are open to the public.
The polygon count is not an attraction count.

sources.title: Historic Sites (GEOJSON)
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.purpose: Historic site and commemorative marker candidates, with names, locations, descriptions and official detail links.
cautions: Some historic buildings may no longer exist.
A commemorative marker does not establish that a venue can be entered.
Access conditions require verification.

sources.title: Monuments (GEOJSON)
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.purpose: National monument candidates for exploring architecture and culture. Viewing from outside and visiting inside must be distinguished.
cautions: Monument status does not imply public access.
Do not assume free entry or round-the-clock access.
Check for duplicates across sources while retaining every source record.

sources.title: Hawker Centres (GEOJSON)
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.catalogue_updated_note: Source shows relative update time; not converted to an exact timestamp
sources.purpose: Candidates for local leisure and food stops, including location, name and status fields.
cautions: Markets and hawker centres must be distinguished.
A centre location does not establish that every stall is open.
Static status is not live opening or price information.

sources.title: Park Facilities
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.catalogue_updated_note: Source shows relative update time; not converted to an exact timestamp
sources.purpose: Park facilities. Preserve CLASS and original attributes; do not treat every facility as an attraction.
cautions: A facility representative point does not establish an entrance.
Missing accessibility attributes must not be inferred.
Missing names remain unknown.

sources.title: NParks Tracks
sources.geographic_scope: SG nationwide source coverage; no project area subset
sources.purpose: Park trails and Park Connector Networks. Preserve the walking and cycling permission fields.
cautions: The official source notes possible positional inaccuracies.
This is not a complete, routable walking network for Singapore.
Intersecting lines do not establish a traversable connection at the same level.
